conservative.requirements: Any ally within medium range is injured as described below. Effect: Where suffers 2 or more wounds, suffers a critical wound, or acquires an insanity, a disease, or a new symptom, you may place 6 recharge tokens on this card to immediately gain {Dc}.

reckless.requirements: An ally within medium range is injured as described below. Special: If you have Piety Mastery, gain 1 additional favour. Effect: When an ally within medium range suffers 2 or more wounds, suffers a critical wound, or acquires an insanity, a disease, or a new symptom, you may place 6 recharge tokens on this card to immediately gain favour equal to your character rank.
